title: Qian Min v. Sun Hao, right to health · The facts (fictional: charging in a corridor)

groups.label: Done by both, or the objective course

axis.label: Done by both, or the objective course

sources.name: Corridor surveillance video
sources.quote: At 20:14:03 on 2 June 2030 Qian Min was charging an e-bike battery in the ground-floor corridor … at 20:14:16 the two began to talk … at 20:16:24 they left the corridor

sources.name: Building entrance surveillance video
sources.quote: At 20:18:40 the two reached the building entrance; Qian Min spoke quickly, Sun Hao evenly. At 20:19:06 they walked towards the property duty room; the charging cable was still in Qian Min's hand

sources.name: Property duty room doorway surveillance video
sources.quote: Sun Hao spoke evenly throughout; the two only talked, with no pulling and no physical contact … the three videos show that the two were in contact for under five minutes

sources.name: Emergency record of Example City First Hospital
sources.quote: Ambulance called at 20:21; the crew reached the patient at 20:27

sources.name: Interview record of a property staff member (fictional)
sources.quote: Two minutes later the emergency centre called and asked me to meet them at the estate gate; I took calls at 20:30 and 20:32

sources.name: Second-instance judgment in this case (fictional)

loc.court: Example City Intermediate People's Court, Example Province

sources.quote: Sun Hao's objection did not go beyond what was needed and was a proper dissuasion … there is no legal causation between the two, and Sun Hao was not at fault

events.label: Sun Hao enters the corridor and presses the lift button
events.detail: At 20:14:07 Sun Hao entered the ground-floor corridor and pressed the lift's up button

events.label: Qian Min charges a battery in the corridor
events.detail: Qian Min was charging an e-bike battery from the wall socket in the ground-floor corridor

events.label: The two talk on in the corridor (the objection)
events.detail: The two began to talk and kept talking while the lift came and went, with some sharp words; at 20:16:24 they left the corridor. The three videos show they were in contact for under five minutes

events.label: At the building entrance Qian Min speaks quickly
events.detail: Qian Min spoke quickly, Sun Hao evenly

events.label: They walk to the duty room, cable still in Qian Min's hand
events.detail: The two walked towards the property duty room; the charging cable was still in Qian Min's hand

events.label: Ambulance called
events.detail: The emergency record says: ambulance called at 20:21, crew reached the patient at 20:27. The judgment does not say who made the call

events.dateNote: The video clock reads 20:33:55 to 20:38:56; checked against the emergency record and the interview record, the real time is about 20:23 (the video clock runs about ten minutes fast)
events.label: Row at the duty room door, Sun Hao is led away
events.detail: The two went on talking at the duty room door; Qian Min's voice kept rising and she stepped towards Sun Hao several times, and property supervisor Zhou Qiang pulled them apart; Zhou Qiang led Sun Hao away and Qian Min was taken into the duty room. The property staff Zhou Qiang and Wu Mei took part in calming them (not in the actors list)

events.label: The ambulance crew arrives
events.detail: The ambulance crew reached the patient

events.label: Qian Min has a sudden heart problem and is taken to hospital
events.summary: The judgment gives no time of day
events.detail: Qian Min, still upset, had a sudden heart problem and was taken to hospital for treatment (the judgment simplifies the onset and gives no time of day, so date is exact only to the day)
